field_evidence.footprint: Historic England publishes Listed Buildings as polygons via its Open Data Hub, but the static Shapefile archive was not retrieved and no ListEntry 1306502 polygon coordinates were read.
field_evidence.type_use: Official NHLE record explicitly identifies Bridge Inn as an C18 coaching inn/public house, with former malthouse/brewery, at Topsham, Exeter.
field_evidence.heritage: Official NHLE record identifies List Entry 1306502, Grade II, first listed 11 November 1952, most recently amended 7 June 2022.

evidence_slice: Historic England's official NHLE record 1306502 identifies Bridge Inn, Bridge Hill, Topsham, Exeter, Devon EX3 0QQ, Grade II, as an C18 coaching inn/public house with a former malthouse/brewery, with most recent amendment dated 7 June 2022. Historic England's official data-downloads page publishes 'Listed Buildings as polygons' through its Open Data Hub and states that NHLE data is downloadable in a range of formats and APIs under the Open Government Licence. The new source window used the Open Data Hub static Shapefile distribution route for layer 3 with a planned exact post-download filter to ListEntry 1306502. The web retrieval channel could not access the static download endpoint, and direct network resolution failed before any archive bytes or record geometry were read.
